summary.zh-CN: 把业务数据做成看板时自动使用：读字段、试跑只读 SQL，生成组件与看板草案，由你在业务页预览确认。
summary.en: Used automatically when turning business data into a dashboard: reads fields, trial-runs read-only SQL and drafts widgets and a dashboard for you to preview and confirm on the Business page.

modifications.zh-CN: Teloa 自编内置技能，没有原始来源（upstream 为 null），随 Teloa 安装包提供，不进在线索引。
modifications.en: Built-in skill authored by Teloa with no original source (upstream is null); it comes with Teloa and is not in the online index.

conditions.zh-CN: 只在本人普通会话中提供，同事执行任务时不可见。
conditions.en: Available only in your own ordinary conversations; not visible to colleagues running tasks.

conditions.zh-CN: 草案须由本人在「业务 > 看板 > 待确认」预览并确认后才生效。
conditions.en: Drafts take effect only after you preview and confirm them under Business > Dashboards > Pending.
